notes.title: Introducing the Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We hope you’re enjoying the holiday season! This year, to celebrate the Steam Winter Sale, we’ve created the Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection, combining Gal*Gun: Double Peace, Gal*Gun 2, and Gal*Gun Returns into one irresistible package!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260032/b63a37a2f0fbb538ed63912c933b3449501528f9.jpg

The Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection includes a 15% discount and is ‘complete the set’ so you can pick up any of the titles you’re missing and still receive the discount. All three titles will also be on sale from now until January 2nd, so it's absolutely the best time to complete your collection or, for newcomers to the series, indulge your curiosity…

It's never too late to jump into the Gal*Gun universe which is expanding into the realms of metroidvania! Gal Guardians: Demon Purge sees the Kamizono sisters as demon hunters battling through their high school which has been transformed into a demonic castle. We’ve also recently announced a sequel, Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark, which features demon sisters Kirika and Masha on a bloody quest to revive their demon lord.

Wishing you all the very best this holiday season and a wonderful new year 💞

PQube and Inti Creates

notes.title: Gal*Gun Returns Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26356630/61be2ca14c0368d0a813610f0d8dbbb9202c04db.jpg

Hey Gal*Gunners!

We’re so happy to finally release Gal*Gun Returns on Steam today! We know you’ve all been excited to play the very first game in the series. Check out our brand-new launch trailer below!

[previewyoutube=W14zUn5eSTU;full][/previewyoutube]

We will also be taking a look at Kaoruko’s route with PQube Community Manager Kiera at 16:00 GMT (08:00 PT) later today on the Gal*Gun Returns Store Page.

Gal*Gun Returns will be 10% off on Steam until 19th February, so now’s a great time to pick it up!

We also have the Gal*Gun series on sale right now, just in case you’re missing anything from your collection. 

Gal*Gun: Double Peace, originally launched in 2016, is 75% off (with 50% off all DLC) until 17th February 2021.
 Gal*Gun 2 from 2018 is 25% off (with 20% off all DLC) until 20th February 2021.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425730/GalGun_Returns/

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Just to let you know we've fired out our first patch to obliterate some issues that have been reported on the Gal*Gun discussions page and on social media. We're keeping our sights pin-pointed on all activity so it is greatly appreciated when players report any issues that pop up. Thanks to everyone for your support so far!

Changelog
- A bug that was causing the physics engine to work improperly in some places has been fixed.
- Various other small bugs have been fixed.
